cases.rationale: A server secret detected in a client artifact must fail the security gate.
Administrative access must be enforced server-side.
A clean scan is only a scoped result and must not be represented as proof of overall security.

required: CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM generated from the exact candidate lockfile
SARIF report from a named scanner and exact workflow run
Dependency audit output with tool and database timestamp
AgentShield evidence pack only if that scanner is actually used
externalArtifacts.rule: Do not create placeholder reports or claim scanner execution without source artifacts.
